newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran, China sign $125 million locomotive deal.
newsitem.headline: Iran, China sign $125 million locomotive deal.

text.p: Iran and China on Tuesday signed a $125 million agreement to jointly manufacture 100 locomotives, the Iranian news agency IRNA said.
It said officials from the two countries signed the accord in Tehran to build the locomotives over the next five years.

The deal provided for the transfer of energy to Iran and for using some Iranian parts in producing the 4,000 horsepower locomotives. It did not say where they would be built and did not give further details.

It was not immediately clear if the project was linked to the construction of Tehran's subway with Chinese cooperation. A subsidiary of the People's Insurance Company of China last year signed a $450 million export insurance agreement for the project.

The subway project consists of supplying power, signalling, ventilation and maintenance equipment for two subway lines, supplying 218 passenger cars and building an electric railway line in Tehran's suburbs.
